title: kbgit sync retries a fetch that another worktree's fetch of the same ref holds
goal: kbgit.py sync tries git fetch origin again after a pause when it fails with cannot lock ref refs/remotes/origin/main ... but expected, as the push already does, instead of exiting 2

run:
import sys,inspect;sys.path.insert(0,'_tools');import kg_sync as k
s=inspect.getsource(k)
i=s.find('git fetch origin failed')
print(i)
sys.exit(0 if i>0 and 'cannot lock ref' in s[max(0,i-1500):i] else 1)

notes: SP-2uljwgho retro: land ST-7jjj3b4s stopped at step kbgit.py sync --push with exit 2: 'git fetch origin failed: error: cannot lock ref refs/remotes/origin/main: is at 942cfa81 but expected 6160edf3' while another linked worktree's sync fetched (host main lock held by its pid); a plain retry of land passed. The check is a source read only (the race needs two processes); a planted check that runs sync against a ref held by a second fetch should replace it at planning.
